decision: PASS. The supplied portrait and landscape artwork establish the intended professional aftermath: Nika remains engaged in written documentation at a desk covered with plans and reference materials, while Leo physically departs through a sunlit doorway. Their separation, contrasting actions, and restrained expressions preserve an unresolved interpersonal tension without presenting romantic reconciliation or closure. Nika's appearance remains consistent with her approved reference through her short, tousled dark-brown hair, facial features, gold jewelry, and cream linen clothing. Leo retains his recognizable hairstyle, facial structure, pale linen suit, muted green shirt, and brown leather satchel. Both compositions maintain character identity and narrative clarity. The desktop runtime preserves the landscape composition, while both mobile runtimes preserve Nika's writing activity and enough of Leo's departing figure to communicate the scene. Mobile cropping is more pronounced at 390 pixels, but does not materially obscure the intended action. Navigation controls and Russian dialogue remain legible against the runtime overlays. The journal visibly contains written and diagrammatic material, although its precise handover/status wording cannot be verified from the pixels. Likewise, the doorway's identification as the west wing is contextual rather than visually established. Neither limitation constitutes an actionable visual defect. No material composition, continuity, readability, or narrative-staging defects are evident in the supplied images.

visualEvidence.observation: The three-panel reference establishes Nika with a short, voluminous, tousled dark-brown bob, expressive brown eyes, softly defined facial features, and small gold hoop earrings. She wears an open-collar cream linen blouse, beige high-waisted trousers, a brown leather belt, and a dark leather shoulder bag. The central portrait clearly establishes her facial proportions, while the side portrait establishes her hairstyle and profile.

The reference establishes Leo with medium-length, side-swept light-brown hair, a relatively angular face, defined cheekbones, and a restrained expression. His clothing consists of a pale linen jacket and matching trousers over a muted olive-green shirt, complemented by brown loafers and a leather shoulder satchel. The full-body reference includes rolled architectural plans, establishing a professional context.

The portrait artwork places Nika prominently in the left foreground, seated at a large wooden desk and writing with a dark pen in an open journal containing handwritten marks and diagrams. Books, loose plans, storage boxes, and drafting materials establish a working environment. Leo appears farther back at the right, stepping through a sunlit doorway while looking over his shoulder. His pale linen clothing and brown shoulder satchel remain recognizable. Warm directional light distinguishes the departing figure from Nika's comparatively stationary work. The image contains no application navigation or dialogue overlay.

The landscape artwork presents Nika on the left, looking down while writing in an open journal on a desk covered with documents and plans. Leo is shown farther away on the right, walking toward the bright exterior through open glass doors. His satchel and the rectangular document or portfolio carried in his hand reinforce the professional setting. The architectural interior, shelves, maps, and exterior stonework provide spatial context. The composition establishes the characters' physical separation while keeping both recognizable. No dialogue or navigation chrome is embedded in the source image.

The 1280×720 desktop runtime displays the landscape composition with Nika writing in the left foreground and Leo departing in the right background. The top navigation controls, including Назад and Меню, remain visible. A dark gradient covers the lower portion of the scene to support the dialogue interface. The speaker label ЛЕО and the Russian dialogue are legible. The gradient darkens the desk and lower portions of the characters but does not obscure Nika's writing action or Leo's departure. Both principal characters remain compositionally distinct.

The 390×844 mobile runtime uses a vertical composition with Nika seated and writing prominently in the left foreground. Leo appears behind her near the right boundary, with part of his figure cropped by the screen edge. His brown satchel, pale jacket, and movement toward the doorway remain discernible. The navigation controls fit at the top. A dark lower gradient provides contrast for the speaker label and the Russian dialogue, which wraps across three visible lines without apparent clipping. Nika's face, writing hand, and open journal remain visible.

The 360×640 mobile runtime retains the vertical staging, with Nika occupying the left foreground and Leo positioned near the doorway on the right. Nika's pen, writing hand, and open journal remain recognizable despite the smaller viewport. Leo's head, torso, satchel, and departing posture are visible. The dark dialogue treatment occupies a substantial lower portion of the screen, but the speaker label and complete Russian dialogue remain readable across three lines. The top navigation controls are visible, and no material collision between the dialogue text and interface controls is apparent.
